content.value_statement: Svelte teams need clear guidance for rendering Markdown and streaming chat responses. This skill provides focused integration guidance for markstream-svelte in Svelte 5 applications.
actual_capabilities: Confirms that the project uses Svelte 5 before recommending integration steps.
Guides use of MarkdownRender for Markdown content rendering.
Explains smooth streaming, typewriter, and fade settings for chat responses.
Describes separate settings for live streaming and recovered chat history.
Identifies worker hooks for KaTeX and Mermaid rendering.
Suggests validation with svelte-check, a build, or end-to-end tests.
limitations: It does not support Svelte 4 integration guidance.
It does not install packages or modify project files by itself.
It does not replace package documentation for every markstream-svelte API.
It does not diagnose browser-specific rendering failures without project details.

use_cases.title: Add a Markdown chat renderer
use_cases.description: Set up a Svelte 5 chat view that renders assistant Markdown responses.

use_cases.title: Tune streaming response behavior
use_cases.description: Choose smooth streaming, cursor, and fade settings for live and completed messages.

use_cases.title: Prepare rich content workers
use_cases.description: Plan KaTeX and Mermaid worker configuration for Markdown content with math and diagrams.

prompt_templates.title: Check project compatibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me confirm whether my Svelte project can use markstream-svelte. List the required Svelte version and the first integration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Render Markdown content
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to structure a Svelte 5 component that renders a Markdown content value with markstream-svelte. Include CSS placement guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Configure live chat streaming
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure markstream-svelte for a live chat response. Explain smooth streaming, typewriter, and fade settings and why each is appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Handle streaming and history
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Svelte 5 message renderer that switches between live streaming and recovered history. Include final-state behavior, worker considerations, and a validation checklist.

output_examples.input: I need a renderer for a live Svelte 5 chat message.
output: Use MarkdownRender with the message content value.
Use automatic smooth streaming for the live message.
Enable the cursor effect and disable fade to avoid flicker during gradual updates.

output_examples.input: A saved conversation is loading slowly.
output: Treat the saved message as completed content.
Disable smooth streaming because the content is already available.
Enable fade for a polished entry animation.

output_examples.input: My Markdown includes math and diagrams.
output: Load the required CSS after reset styles.
Plan KaTeX and Mermaid worker setup.
Run svelte-check and a production build after configuration.

best_practices: Use separate settings for live streaming and completed history.
Validate changes with svelte-check, a production build, and relevant end-to-end tests.
anti_patterns: Do not use this guidance for Svelte 4 projects.
Do not apply live streaming pacing to already completed history.
Do not omit required CSS or worker setup when using math or diagram features.

faq.question: Which Svelte version does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Svelte 5. It directs Svelte 4 users to upgrade before integration.

faq.question: What component should render Markdown?
faq.answer: The guidance uses MarkdownRender with a content value as the standard starting point.

faq.question: When should I use smooth streaming?
faq.answer: Use it for content that arrives gradually in a live chat response.

faq.question: How should completed history be rendered?
faq.answer: Disable smooth streaming for completed history and use fade if an entry animation is desired.

faq.question: Does it cover KaTeX and Mermaid?
faq.answer: It identifies worker hooks for KaTeX and Mermaid and reminds you to load required CSS.

faq.question: How should I verify the integration?
faq.answer: Run svelte-check, build the application, and add relevant end-to-end tests.
